Frequently Asked Questions

Is it too late if my parent is already receiving care?

If care has already started, we can begin by reviewing what is happening now: the care setting, timing, costs, and questions your family needs answered. The consultation helps us determine whether a more detailed planning review would be useful. We cannot determine eligibility or promise an outcome from a brief conversation.

Can we explore options if my parent owns a home or has savings?

We can review your family’s circumstances and identify the questions that need a closer look. How a home or savings affects eligibility depends on the applicable program and individual facts. Planning recommendations require a detailed review with the appropriate professionals.

Can Medi-Cal help with care outside a nursing home?

Care at home, assisted living, and PACE are among the options we can help your family explore. Coverage, services, and availability depend on the specific program and individual eligibility. We will help you identify which questions to investigate for your loved one’s care needs and location.

What happens during the free consultation?

During the 15-minute conversation, you can tell Richard about your loved one’s care needs, your timing, and the questions on your mind. You will discuss whether the service is a fit and what a next step could look like. A detailed discovery review with Richard and a Medicaid planning attorney is a separate, paid step.

Certified Medicaid Planner • Founder

Richard Ladson, CMP™

Richard founded National Medicaid Planning to help families make sense of long-term care planning, with a particular focus on the questions families face when a loved one needs Alzheimer’s or dementia care.

He helps families understand the planning process and coordinates with attorneys and other professionals for the review, planning, and application support their situation requires.

The initial service focus is California, where Medicaid is called Medi-Cal. Legal services, when needed, are provided by licensed attorneys.

Website information

Privacy Policy

This website provides information about National Medicaid Planning LLC and ways to contact Richard Ladson.

Using this website

This website does not currently include a contact form, advertising trackers, or analytics scripts. Phone links open your calling application and email links open your email application. The website is hosted by Netlify, which may process technical information such as IP addresses and request logs needed to serve and secure the website. If an online booking link is enabled, the booking provider’s privacy practices also apply.

Contacting Richard

If you call or email, you choose the information you provide. Your phone or email provider’s own privacy practices apply. Please do not send sensitive medical, financial, or identification documents through an initial email. Ask Richard about an appropriate process for sharing documents.

Privacy questions

Contact richard@nationalmedicaidplanning.com or call 909.602.4125 with questions about information you have shared or to request an update or deletion.

Website information

Terms

About the service

National Medicaid Planning LLC is a private planning service and is not affiliated with a government agency. Richard Ladson is a Certified Medicaid Planner. Legal services, when needed, are provided by licensed attorneys.

Information on this website

The website introduces the service and planning process. It does not provide an individual eligibility determination, a personalized legal or financial recommendation, or a guarantee of approval, savings, or other results. Eligibility and results vary.

Consultations and further services

The introductory consultation is a free 15-minute conversation. A detailed discovery review and further planning services are separate steps. Any scope of services and fees must be agreed before an engagement begins. Calling or emailing to request a consultation does not confirm an appointment.

Questions

For questions about the service, contact Richard Ladson or call 909.602.4125.
